title: Accountants and auditors
rationale: Predominantly knowledge work involving financial records, tax preparation, auditing, and advisory — almost entirely digital. AI copilots by 2028 handle routine analysis, report drafting, and compliance checks, yielding 2-3x productivity gains. However, client advisory, fraud detection, and complex judgment calls still require experienced human professionals.

title: Actors
rationale: Core work is physical human performance — auditions, rehearsals, live and filmed acting — which AI cannot replicate for most contexts by 2028. However, AI-generated synthetic media is beginning to displace voiceover work, background extras, and some digital character work. BLS itself notes AI may replace actors in certain subfields.

title: Actuaries
rationale: Almost entirely digital work: statistical modeling, risk analysis, financial forecasting, and report writing. AI excels at data analysis and pattern recognition in structured datasets. By 2028, AI copilots significantly accelerate routine modeling and analysis, but deep domain expertise, certification requirements, and regulatory judgment provide meaningful insulation for experienced practitioners.

title: Administrative services and facilities managers
rationale: A mix of digital knowledge work (records management, procurement, scheduling, reporting) and physical facility oversight (building inspections, maintenance supervision, staff management). AI meaningfully assists administrative and records functions by 2028, but facilities management requires physical presence, interpersonal leadership, and real-time judgment about building operations.

title: Adult basic and secondary education and ESL teachers
rationale: Core work is face-to-face instruction with adult learners from diverse backgrounds, requiring cultural sensitivity, patience, and adaptive teaching methods. AI tutoring tools assist with lesson planning and content delivery by 2028, but the interpersonal relationship, in-person assessment of learning disabilities, and community resource coordination remain fundamentally human tasks.

title: Advertising sales agents
rationale: Work is predominantly digital: locating clients, making presentations, preparing sales literature, media kits, and processing correspondence. AI assists with prospect research, proposal generation, and ad performance analytics by 2028. However, relationship building and client negotiation remain human-driven.

title: Advertising, promotions, and marketing managers
rationale: Core duties—market research analysis, campaign planning, budget management, and creative direction—are heavily digital. AI copilots by 2028 accelerate content creation, audience targeting, and performance analytics. Strategic decision-making, team leadership, and client relationships still require human judgment.

title: Aerospace engineering and operations technologists and technicians
rationale: Core work involves physically building, installing, calibrating, and maintaining test equipment and aircraft systems. While they record data and use computer systems, the hands-on laboratory and manufacturing floor work dominates. AI helps with data recording and simulation but cannot replace physical tasks.

title: Aerospace engineers
rationale: Design work using CAD/CAE software, simulation, and analysis is heavily digital. AI copilots assist with design optimization, code generation for simulations, and technical documentation by 2028. However, physical testing, safety-critical judgment, and regulatory compliance require deep human expertise.

title: Agricultural and food science technicians
rationale: Core duties involve hands-on lab and field work: collecting samples, operating equipment, examining specimens, and maintaining sterile environments. Report preparation and data compilation benefit from AI, but the physical specimen handling and equipment operation dominate the role.

title: Agricultural and food scientists
rationale: A blend of field research, laboratory work, and knowledge work including data analysis, report writing, and compliance documentation. AI meaningfully assists literature review, data analysis, and report generation by 2028, but field research, physical experiments, and regulatory oversight require human expertise.

title: Agricultural engineers
rationale: Design work using computer software, climate modeling, and system optimization is substantially digital. AI assists with design tools, simulation, and technical documentation. However, physical site visits, equipment testing, and direct collaboration with farmers and contractors remain essential.

title: Agricultural workers
rationale: Almost entirely physical labor: planting, harvesting, irrigating, operating farm machinery, feeding livestock, and cleaning animal enclosures. Minimal digital component beyond basic equipment operation. AI has negligible impact on day-to-day physical farm tasks by 2028.

title: Air traffic controllers
rationale: Work involves real-time monitoring of radar/computer systems and radio communication with pilots—a mix of digital tools and high-stakes human judgment. AI aids with traffic flow optimization and weather integration, but safety-critical real-time decision-making and direct communication with pilots remain firmly human due to regulatory and safety constraints.

title: Aircraft and avionics equipment mechanics and technicians
rationale: Predominantly hands-on physical work: repairing aircraft components, testing electronic equipment, installing instruments using hand and power tools. Record-keeping and reading technical manuals benefit from AI, but the core physical repair and inspection work under strict FAA regulations is unaffected.

title: Airline and commercial pilots
rationale: Core work is physically operating aircraft, conducting pre-flight inspections, and managing real-time flight decisions. While cockpit instruments are computerized and AI assists with flight planning and navigation, the physical presence, safety responsibility, and real-time judgment in the cockpit cannot be automated by 2028.

title: Animal care and service workers
rationale: Almost entirely physical and interpersonal: feeding, grooming, exercising, training animals, and cleaning their living spaces. Scheduling appointments and basic record-keeping are minor digital components. AI has minimal impact on the hands-on animal care that defines this role.

title: Announcers and DJs
rationale: A mix of live performance (presenting, interviewing, emceeing events) and digital content work (researching topics, selecting content, operating studio equipment). AI-generated voices and content curation tools are emerging by 2028, affecting pre-recorded and routine broadcast segments, but live personality-driven performance remains human.

title: Anthropologists and archeologists
rationale: Fieldwork (excavation, observation, interviews) is physical, but substantial knowledge work includes data analysis, report writing, and research planning. AI assists with literature review, data pattern analysis, and report drafting by 2028. The blend of field and desk work places this at moderate exposure.

title: Arbitrators, mediators, and conciliators
rationale: Core work is interpersonal: facilitating dialogue, managing conflict, and guiding negotiations between parties. However, legal research, document review, and settlement agreement preparation are digital tasks AI can assist with. The essential human skills of empathy, persuasion, and real-time negotiation limit overall exposure.

title: Architects
rationale: Design work using CAD software, preparing specifications, and contract documents is heavily digital. AI tools by 2028 assist with generative design, code compliance checking, and documentation. However, client meetings, site visits, creative vision, and construction oversight require significant human involvement.

title: Architectural and engineering managers
rationale: Management duties include project planning, budgeting, staff coordination, and technical oversight—substantially digital. AI assists with project tracking, report generation, and resource planning. However, leadership, hiring decisions, cross-functional collaboration, and technical judgment remain human-driven.

title: Archivists, curators, and museum workers
rationale: A blend of physical work (restoring objects, managing collections, designing exhibits) and digital tasks (cataloging, creating digital records, research). AI helps with cataloging and digital preservation by 2028, but physical conservation, exhibit curation, and public engagement require human expertise and presence.

title: Art directors
rationale: Work is predominantly digital: developing visual styles, reviewing designs, coordinating creative teams, and presenting concepts to clients. AI image generation and design tools substantially assist production work by 2028. However, creative vision, team management, and client relationship skills remain essential human contributions.

title: Assemblers and fabricators
rationale: Core work is physical assembly using hand and power tools: positioning parts, connecting components, conducting quality checks, and maintaining equipment. Reading schematics has a minor digital component, but the overwhelmingly manual nature of assembly work means AI has minimal direct impact by 2028.

title: Athletes and sports competitors
rationale: Core value is entirely physical: practicing, training, exercising, and competing in sporting events. While AI assists with performance analytics and video review, the fundamental work product—athletic performance—is entirely non-digital and cannot be automated.

title: Athletic trainers
rationale: Predominantly physical and interpersonal: applying bandages and braces, providing first aid, developing rehabilitation programs, and working directly with athletes. Administrative duties like record-keeping and treatment planning benefit from AI, but hands-on patient care dominates.

title: Atmospheric scientists, including meteorologists
rationale: Heavily digital work: analyzing atmospheric data, running computational weather models, preparing forecasts and reports, and using specialized software. AI significantly enhances weather prediction, data analysis, and forecast generation by 2028. Some fieldwork for instrument deployment remains physical.

title: Audiologists
rationale: Core work is clinical and interpersonal: examining patients, conducting hearing tests, fitting hearing devices, and counseling patients on treatment. While diagnostic equipment is computerized and AI may assist with test interpretation, the direct patient care and physical examination components dominate.

title: Automotive body and glass repairers
rationale: Predominantly hands-on physical work: removing dents, replacing panels, refinishing surfaces, and installing windshields. Damage estimation and cost reporting have digital components that AI can assist with, but the core repair work is entirely manual.

title: Automotive service technicians and mechanics
rationale: Core duties are physical: inspecting, maintaining, and repairing vehicles using diagnostic equipment and hand tools. While computerized diagnostics are integral, the hands-on repair, parts replacement, and testing work dominates. AI assists with diagnostics and service manual lookup but cannot perform physical repairs.

title: Bakers
rationale: Almost entirely physical work: measuring ingredients, mixing dough, kneading, shaping, and baking products. Inventory management is a minor digital component. AI has negligible impact on the manual food preparation that defines this role.

title: Barbers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists
rationale: Core work is entirely physical and interpersonal: cutting, styling, and coloring hair, skin care, and direct client interaction. Appointment scheduling is a minor digital component. AI cannot perform physical grooming services.

title: Bartenders
rationale: Core duties are physical and interpersonal: mixing drinks, serving customers, managing bar inventory, and ensuring responsible alcohol service. POS system use is a minor digital component. AI has minimal impact on the in-person service nature of this work.

title: Bill and account collectors
rationale: Work is almost entirely screen-based: using databases to find debtors, making phone calls, sending correspondence, negotiating repayment plans, and recording account information. AI chatbots and automated outreach systems can handle routine collection tasks by 2028, with active displacement of entry-level positions.

title: Biochemists and biophysicists
rationale: A significant blend of physical lab work (conducting experiments, operating equipment) and digital knowledge work (data analysis, modeling, report writing, literature review). AI meaningfully assists with computational biology, protein structure prediction, and manuscript preparation by 2028, but wet-lab experimental work remains human.

title: Bioengineers and biomedical engineers
rationale: Core duties include designing medical devices using CAD, developing software for medical systems, and writing technical reports—substantially digital. AI assists with design optimization, simulation, and documentation. Physical prototyping, clinical testing, and regulatory navigation require human expertise.

title: Biological technicians
rationale: Primarily hands-on laboratory work: setting up equipment, collecting samples, conducting experiments, and maintaining sterile environments. Data recording and report preparation have digital components that AI assists with, but the physical laboratory operations dominate day-to-day work.

title: Boilermakers
rationale: Almost entirely physical skilled trade work: reading blueprints, welding, installing boilers, and performing structural repairs using hand and power tools. The work requires physical presence in industrial settings with minimal digital component beyond blueprint reading.

title: Bookkeeping, accounting, and auditing clerks
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based work: entering financial data, using bookkeeping software, producing reports, and reconciling records. AI can automate most routine data entry, classification, and report generation by 2028. Active headcount reduction is underway as organizations consolidate these roles.

title: Broadcast, sound, and video technicians
rationale: A mix of physical equipment setup and operation with digital editing and monitoring. While AI assists with automated mixing, editing, and quality control for recorded content, live broadcast operation and physical equipment management remain hands-on. The role bridges physical and digital work.

title: Budget analysts
rationale: Almost entirely digital: analyzing financial data in spreadsheets, preparing budget reports, reviewing spending patterns, and writing recommendations. AI excels at financial modeling, variance analysis, and report drafting by 2028. Routine budget analysis is highly automatable, with experienced analysts focusing on strategic advisory.

title: Bus drivers
rationale: Core work is entirely physical: operating a large vehicle, managing passenger safety, navigating routes, and performing pre-trip inspections. While GPS and scheduling systems are digital, the fundamental task of safely driving a bus with passengers requires physical presence that AI cannot replace by 2028.

title: Butchers
rationale: Almost entirely physical work: receiving meat, cutting, deboning, grinding, weighing, and packaging products. Customer interaction and inventory are minor components. AI has negligible impact on the manual meat processing skills that define this trade.

title: Calibration technologists and technicians
rationale: Primarily hands-on work: inspecting, adjusting, and testing precision measurement devices against standards. While documentation and data comparison have digital aspects that AI assists with, the physical calibration of instruments and equipment requires manual skill and precision.

title: Cardiovascular technologists and technicians
rationale: Core work involves hands-on patient care: conducting cardiac tests, assisting in procedures, operating imaging equipment, and monitoring patients. While test results are digitally processed and AI assists with image analysis, the physical patient interaction and equipment operation dominate.

title: Career and technical education teachers
rationale: Teaching vocational skills (auto repair, cosmetology, culinary arts) involves significant hands-on demonstration and student supervision. Lesson planning, curriculum development, and grading benefit from AI by 2028, but the physical instruction and mentoring in trades remains fundamentally human.

title: Carpenters
rationale: Almost entirely physical work: constructing, installing, and repairing building frameworks using hand and power tools. Reading blueprints is a minor digital component. AI has negligible impact on the manual carpentry skills that define this trade.

title: Cartographers and photogrammetrists
rationale: Almost entirely digital work: using GIS software, remote sensing data, and computer tools to create and update maps. AI significantly accelerates geospatial data analysis, automated feature extraction, and map generation by 2028. Most output is delivered digitally with minimal fieldwork required.

title: Cashiers
rationale: Core work is in-person customer interaction: scanning items, processing payments, and providing service. While POS systems are digital, the role requires physical presence and customer-facing engagement. Self-checkout technology displaces some positions, but AI's impact is primarily through automation of the physical checkout process rather than digital AI tools.

title: Chefs and head cooks
rationale: Predominantly physical work: food preparation, cooking, kitchen management, and quality control. Menu planning and inventory management have digital components where AI can assist, but the hands-on culinary work and kitchen leadership are entirely non-digital.

title: Chemical engineers
rationale: Substantial digital work in process design, simulation, data analysis, and technical documentation using specialized software. AI assists with process optimization, safety analysis, and report generation by 2028. However, plant visits, equipment oversight, and safety-critical judgment require physical presence and human expertise.

title: Chemical technicians
rationale: Primarily hands-on laboratory work: monitoring chemical processes, testing product quality, operating instruments, and maintaining equipment. Data recording and analysis have digital components, but the physical laboratory operations and quality control testing dominate the role.

title: Chemists and materials scientists
rationale: A blend of physical lab work (carrying out experiments, operating instruments) and digital knowledge work (data analysis, computational modeling, report writing). AI assists with molecular modeling, literature review, and data analysis by 2028, but hands-on experimental work remains essential.

title: Childcare workers
rationale: Almost entirely physical and interpersonal: supervising children, organizing activities, preparing meals, and fostering early development. The work requires constant physical presence and human care that AI cannot replace. Record-keeping is a negligible digital component.

title: Chiropractors
rationale: Core work is physical patient care: spinal manipulation, musculoskeletal assessment, and hands-on treatment. Patient records, imaging review, and treatment planning have digital components where AI assists, but the essential hands-on therapeutic work and patient interaction dominate.

title: Civil engineering technologists and technicians
rationale: A mix of field work (site inspections, surveying, materials testing) and digital tasks (drafting using CAD, analyzing data, preparing reports). AI assists with design drafting and data analysis by 2028, but physical site work and hands-on testing remain significant portions of the role.

title: Civil engineers
rationale: Substantial digital work: using CAD and simulation software for design, analyzing data, preparing project specifications, and writing reports. AI assists with design optimization and documentation by 2028. However, site visits, construction supervision, and safety-critical regulatory judgment require human presence and expertise.

title: Claims adjusters, appraisers, examiners, and investigators
rationale: Predominantly digital work: reviewing claims documentation, analyzing policy coverage, calculating settlements, and preparing reports. AI significantly accelerates claims processing, fraud detection, and damage estimation by 2028. Physical site inspections for complex claims provide some insulation.

title: Clinical laboratory technologists and technicians
rationale: Core work is hands-on laboratory testing: preparing specimens, operating complex analytical equipment, and performing quality control. While lab information systems and AI-assisted diagnostics are part of the digital infrastructure, the physical specimen handling and equipment operation dominate daily work.

title: Coaches and scouts
rationale: Primarily physical and interpersonal: conducting practices, teaching techniques, providing motivation, and attending games. Scouting involves video analysis and statistical evaluation where AI helps by 2028, but the core coaching relationship and in-person instruction remain fundamentally human.

title: Community health workers
rationale: Core work is interpersonal and community-based: conducting outreach, providing health education, connecting people with services, and advocating for underserved populations. Record-keeping and resource coordination have digital components, but the face-to-face community engagement dominates.

title: Compensation and benefits managers
rationale: Predominantly digital knowledge work: analyzing salary data, designing compensation structures, managing benefits programs, and ensuring regulatory compliance using HRIS systems. AI assists with market benchmarking, plan modeling, and compliance monitoring by 2028. Staff supervision and strategic decision-making remain human.

title: Compensation, benefits, and job analysis specialists
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: analyzing wage data, evaluating job descriptions, administering benefits programs, and preparing reports. AI significantly assists with salary benchmarking, job classification, and benefits analysis by 2028. Routine analytical tasks face meaningful automation pressure.

title: Compliance officers
rationale: Predominantly digital knowledge work: reviewing regulations, conducting audits, analyzing organizational practices, and preparing compliance reports. AI excels at monitoring regulatory changes, scanning documents for compliance issues, and generating reports by 2028. However, judgment in ambiguous situations and organizational advisory remain human.

title: Computer and information research scientists
rationale: Almost entirely digital: designing algorithms, conducting computing research, writing papers, and developing new technologies. AI accelerates experimentation, code writing, and literature review by 2028. However, novel research direction-setting and theoretical breakthroughs still require deep human expertise, providing some insulation at the senior level.

title: Computer and information systems managers
rationale: Predominantly digital: planning IT strategy, managing technology teams, overseeing system implementations, and coordinating budgets. AI assists with project tracking, capacity planning, and vendor evaluation by 2028. Leadership, cross-functional coordination, and strategic technology decisions remain human-driven.

title: Computer hardware engineers
rationale: Significant digital work in circuit design, simulation, and testing using EDA tools, plus technical documentation. AI assists with design optimization and verification by 2028. Physical prototyping, lab testing, and manufacturing oversight provide meaningful non-digital components.

title: Computer network architects
rationale: Predominantly digital: designing network topologies, evaluating hardware/software, analyzing data traffic, and planning implementations. AI assists with network optimization, security analysis, and capacity planning by 2028. However, strategic architecture decisions and cross-organizational coordination remain human-driven.

title: Computer programmers
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining code. AI coding agents by 2028 can autonomously handle routine coding tasks, translating specifications into working code. Active headcount reduction in pure coding roles as AI handles 50-70% of routine programming. Senior architecture and complex problem-solving remain human.

title: Computer support specialists
rationale: Predominantly digital: troubleshooting software/hardware issues, maintaining networks, training users, and managing IT tickets. AI chatbots and diagnostic tools handle routine support queries by 2028. Some physical hardware maintenance provides insulation, but Tier 1 support faces significant automation.

title: Computer systems analysts
rationale: Almost entirely digital: studying organizational systems, designing IT solutions, preparing specifications, and coordinating implementations. AI assists with requirements analysis, system modeling, and documentation by 2028. Routine systems analysis is highly automatable, with experienced analysts focusing on complex organizational change.

title: Concierges
rationale: A mix of interpersonal service (greeting guests, handling personal requests) and digital tasks (making reservations, researching information, coordinating services). AI chatbots handle routine information requests by 2028, but the personalized, in-person service experience remains human-driven.

title: Conservation scientists and foresters
rationale: Significant fieldwork: inspecting forests, monitoring land quality, and overseeing conservation activities. Data analysis, mapping, and report writing are digital components where AI assists by 2028. The blend of outdoor field work and office-based analysis places this at moderate exposure.

title: Construction and building inspectors
rationale: Core work requires physical site visits to inspect structures, verify code compliance, and assess building conditions. While report writing and code reference have digital components AI assists with, the essential on-site inspection and professional judgment require physical presence.

title: Construction equipment operators
rationale: Almost entirely physical: operating heavy machinery like bulldozers, cranes, and excavators on construction sites. Equipment maintenance and GPS-guided operation are minor digital components. AI has negligible impact on the hands-on equipment operation that defines this role.

title: Construction laborers and helpers
rationale: Entirely physical labor: cleaning work areas, loading materials, operating hand tools, and assisting skilled tradespeople. This is one of the most purely physical occupations with virtually no digital component that AI could affect by 2028.

title: Construction managers
rationale: A mix of digital project management (budgeting, scheduling, contract administration, reporting) and physical site oversight. AI assists with cost estimation, schedule optimization, and document management by 2028. However, on-site supervision, contractor coordination, and safety management require significant physical presence.

title: Cooks
rationale: Almost entirely physical work: preparing ingredients, cooking food, plating dishes, and maintaining kitchen cleanliness. POS system interaction is a negligible digital component. AI has minimal impact on the manual culinary tasks that define this role.

title: Correctional officers and bailiffs
rationale: Predominantly physical and interpersonal: supervising inmates, maintaining order, conducting searches, and responding to emergencies. Report writing and record-keeping have digital components, but the core security and supervision work requires constant physical presence.

title: Cost estimators
rationale: Predominantly digital work: analyzing data, calculating material/labor/time costs, using estimation software, and preparing detailed reports. AI significantly enhances cost modeling, historical data analysis, and proposal generation by 2028. Some site visits for complex projects provide partial insulation.

title: Court reporters and simultaneous captioners
rationale: Almost entirely digital output: creating verbatim transcriptions using specialized equipment. AI speech-to-text technology by 2028 can produce highly accurate real-time transcriptions, directly threatening this role. Active displacement is occurring as automated transcription replaces routine proceedings.

title: Craft and fine artists
rationale: Core work is physical creation: painting, sculpting, ceramics, glassblowing, and other hands-on artistic techniques. While AI generates digital art, the physical craft process and unique artistic vision of fine artists remain distinctly human. Marketing and portfolio work have digital components.

title: Credit counselors
rationale: A blend of interpersonal counseling (advising clients on debt management, budgeting) and digital tasks (analyzing financial data, preparing repayment plans, processing applications). AI assists with financial analysis and plan generation by 2028, but the empathetic client relationship and personalized guidance remain human.

title: Customer service representatives
rationale: Predominantly screen-based: handling phone/chat/email inquiries, processing orders, resolving complaints, and updating account records. AI chatbots and virtual agents handle 50-70% of routine customer interactions by 2028. Active headcount reduction in basic customer service roles is underway.

title: Dancers and choreographers
rationale: Core work is physical: performing, rehearsing, and creating dance routines through bodily movement. While choreographers may use video tools and AI-assisted composition software, the essential physical performance and creative embodiment cannot be digitized by 2028.

title: Data scientists
rationale: Almost entirely digital: collecting, analyzing, and modeling data using programming languages and statistical tools. AI significantly accelerates data cleaning, exploratory analysis, model building, and visualization by 2028. Routine data science tasks face strong automation, with experienced practitioners focusing on complex problem framing.

title: Database administrators and architects
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: designing database systems, managing data storage, ensuring security, optimizing performance, and troubleshooting issues. AI assists with query optimization, capacity planning, and automated monitoring by 2028. Routine database administration faces significant automation pressure.

title: Delivery truck drivers and driver/sales workers
rationale: Core work is physical: driving delivery vehicles, loading/unloading packages, navigating routes, and interacting with customers. GPS and routing software are digital tools, but the fundamental task of physically driving and delivering packages requires human presence. Autonomous delivery vehicles remain limited by 2028.

title: Dental and ophthalmic laboratory technicians and medical appliance technicians
rationale: Primarily hands-on manufacturing work: creating dentures, eyeglasses, prosthetics using specialized tools and materials. CAD/CAM technology and 3D printing are increasingly used, with AI assisting design, but manual craftsmanship and fitting remain essential.

title: Dental assistants
rationale: Core work is clinical and hands-on: preparing patients, handing instruments to dentists, taking X-rays, and sterilizing equipment. Record-keeping and appointment scheduling have digital components, but the chairside clinical work dominates the role.

title: Dental hygienists
rationale: Predominantly physical patient care: cleaning teeth, examining patients for oral diseases, applying preventive treatments, and educating patients. Digital charting and X-ray systems are tools used, but the core hands-on clinical work cannot be automated by AI.

title: Dentists
rationale: Core work is clinical: examining patients, diagnosing conditions, performing procedures, and providing treatment. Digital imaging and AI-assisted diagnostics help with treatment planning, but the hands-on surgical and procedural work, patient communication, and clinical judgment dominate.

title: Desktop publishers
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: using design software to create page layouts for print and digital media. AI tools by 2028 can automate template-based layout, typography selection, and image placement. This role faces active displacement as AI handles most production-level desktop publishing tasks.

title: Diagnostic medical sonographers
rationale: Core work is hands-on: operating ultrasound equipment on patients, positioning transducers, and acquiring diagnostic images. While AI assists with image interpretation by 2028, the physical patient interaction, equipment manipulation, and real-time image acquisition require skilled human operators.

title: Diesel service technicians and mechanics
rationale: Core work is hands-on: inspecting, repairing, and overhauling diesel engines using diagnostic equipment and hand tools. Computerized diagnostics aid troubleshooting, but the physical repair, parts replacement, and mechanical work dominate. AI assists with technical manual lookup but cannot perform repairs.

title: Dietitians and nutritionists
rationale: A mix of interpersonal counseling (meeting patients, conducting assessments) and digital knowledge work (meal planning, nutritional analysis, report writing). AI assists with dietary analysis, meal plan generation, and research by 2028, but personalized patient counseling and clinical assessment remain human-driven.

title: Drafters
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: converting designs into technical drawings using CAD software. AI-assisted design tools by 2028 can automate much of routine drafting, including generating standard components and checking compliance. Active headcount pressure in production drafting roles.

title: Drywall installers, ceiling tile installers, and tapers
rationale: Entirely physical work: hanging wallboard, installing ceiling tiles, applying tape and joint compound, and sanding surfaces. This is one of the most purely manual trades with no meaningful digital component that AI could affect by 2028.

title: Economists
rationale: Almost entirely digital: conducting statistical analysis, building economic models, writing research reports, and evaluating policy impacts. AI significantly accelerates data analysis, forecasting, and report drafting by 2028. Routine economic analysis faces strong automation, with senior economists focusing on novel research and policy judgment.

title: Editors
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: reviewing text, correcting errors, verifying facts, and managing content workflows. AI writing and editing tools by 2028 handle much of routine copyediting and proofreading. Active headcount reduction in editorial departments as AI assists with content review and revision.

title: Electrical and electronic engineering technologists and technicians
rationale: A blend of physical work (building prototypes, testing equipment, calibrating instruments) and digital tasks (using CAD, analyzing test data, maintaining records). AI assists with data analysis and design documentation, but hands-on equipment testing and prototyping remain central.

title: Electrical and electronics engineers
rationale: Predominantly digital: designing circuits and systems using EDA software, running simulations, analyzing test data, and writing specifications. AI copilots significantly assist with design optimization and documentation by 2028. Physical prototyping and testing provide some non-digital balance.

title: Electrical and electronics installers and repairers
rationale: Primarily hands-on work: installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical equipment in transportation and industrial settings. Using diagnostic instruments and reading technical manuals have digital components, but the physical installation and repair work dominates.

title: Electrical power-line installers and repairers
rationale: Almost entirely physical outdoor work: climbing utility poles, stringing cables, repairing power lines, and erecting transmission towers. This is dangerous physical labor with virtually no digital component that AI could meaningfully affect by 2028.

title: Electricians
rationale: Predominantly hands-on skilled trade work: installing wiring, outlets, circuit breakers, and maintaining electrical systems. Blueprint reading and code compliance have digital aspects, but the physical electrical work in buildings and factories dominates. AI assists with code lookup but cannot perform installations.

title: Electro-mechanical and mechatronics technologists and technicians
rationale: Core work involves operating, testing, and maintaining automated and robotic equipment—a blend of physical hands-on work and digital monitoring. AI assists with diagnostics and programming, but physical equipment maintenance and troubleshooting remain central.

title: Elementary, middle, and high school principals
rationale: A mix of interpersonal leadership (managing staff, student discipline, parent relations) and digital administrative work (budgeting, scheduling, reporting, curriculum oversight). AI assists with data analysis and administrative tasks by 2028, but the human leadership, community engagement, and judgment calls remain essential.

title: Elevator and escalator installers and repairers
rationale: Almost entirely physical skilled trade work: installing elevator components, troubleshooting mechanical systems, and performing maintenance in confined spaces. Blueprint reading and diagnostic tools are minor digital components. AI has negligible impact on this hands-on trade.

title: Emergency management directors
rationale: A blend of digital planning (developing emergency plans, analyzing risk data, coordinating logistics) and physical/interpersonal response work (leading disaster response, coordinating with officials, conducting community outreach). AI assists with risk modeling and communication planning by 2028.

title: EMTs and paramedics
rationale: Core work is physical emergency response: assessing injuries, providing medical care, transporting patients, and operating emergency vehicles. Electronic patient records and dispatch systems are digital tools, but the hands-on emergency medical care dominates. AI cannot replace physical life-saving interventions.

title: Entertainment and recreation managers
rationale: A mix of digital management (scheduling, budgeting, marketing, reporting) and interpersonal/physical oversight (facility management, staff supervision, community engagement). AI assists with scheduling optimization and marketing content by 2028, but on-site management and personal leadership remain essential.

title: Environmental engineering technologists and technicians
rationale: A blend of physical fieldwork (operating pollution control equipment, collecting samples, site inspections) and digital tasks (maintaining records, analyzing data, preparing reports). AI assists with data analysis and reporting, but hands-on equipment operation and field testing remain significant.

title: Environmental engineers
rationale: Substantial digital work: designing pollution control systems using engineering software, analyzing environmental data, writing impact reports, and modeling solutions. AI assists with simulation, data analysis, and documentation by 2028. Site investigations and regulatory coordination add non-digital components.

title: Environmental science and protection technicians
rationale: A blend of field monitoring (collecting samples, conducting inspections, operating monitoring equipment) and digital tasks (analyzing data, preparing reports, maintaining records). AI assists with data analysis, but physical fieldwork and sample collection remain central.

title: Environmental scientists and specialists
rationale: A mix of fieldwork (collecting environmental samples, conducting site investigations) and digital knowledge work (analyzing data, writing reports, developing remediation plans). AI meaningfully assists with data analysis, modeling, and report generation by 2028, balanced by essential fieldwork.

title: Epidemiologists
rationale: Predominantly digital: analyzing disease data, conducting statistical studies, writing research reports, and developing public health policies. AI significantly accelerates data analysis, pattern detection, and literature review by 2028. Community education and fieldwork investigations provide some non-digital balance.

title: Exercise physiologists
rationale: Core work is hands-on and interpersonal: administering fitness assessments, developing exercise programs, and working directly with patients. Some digital analysis of test results and program documentation exists, but the physical patient interaction and exercise supervision dominate.

title: Farmers, ranchers, and other agricultural managers
rationale: Predominantly physical: overseeing crop production, managing livestock, operating equipment, and maintaining facilities. Financial planning and market analysis have digital components where AI assists, but the hands-on agricultural management and outdoor work dominate.

title: Fashion designers
rationale: Significant digital work: sketching designs using CAD, selecting fabrics and patterns, and creating production specifications. AI image generation tools assist with concept development and trend analysis by 2028. However, physical fabric selection, fitting, and creative artistic vision remain distinctly human.

title: Film and video editors and camera operators

title: Physician assistants
rationale: Predominantly clinical: examining patients, diagnosing conditions, prescribing medications, and performing procedures. AI diagnostic support tools assist with clinical decision-making by 2028, but hands-on patient examination, procedural work, and clinical judgment remain firmly human.

title: Physicians and surgeons
rationale: Core work is clinical: examining patients, performing procedures and surgeries, and making complex diagnostic decisions. AI assists with imaging interpretation, treatment recommendations, and documentation by 2028. However, physical examinations, surgical skills, and life-or-death clinical judgment remain fundamentally human.

title: Physicists and astronomers
rationale: Predominantly digital: running computational simulations, analyzing large datasets, building theoretical models, and writing research papers. AI significantly assists with data analysis, simulation, and literature review by 2028. Some laboratory experiment work and telescope operation provide physical balance.

title: Plumbers, pipefitters, and steamfitters
rationale: Predominantly hands-on skilled trade work: installing and repairing piping systems, soldering, cutting pipe, and testing for leaks. Blueprint reading and cost estimation have minor digital components. AI has minimal impact on the physical plumbing work. Calibration anchor occupation.

title: Podiatrists
rationale: Core work is clinical and procedural: examining feet, diagnosing conditions, prescribing treatments, and performing surgery. Patient records and imaging have digital components, but the hands-on examination and surgical procedures dominate.

title: Police and detectives
rationale: A blend of physical patrol and enforcement with digital investigative work (analyzing evidence, writing reports, searching databases). AI assists with surveillance analysis, report writing, and crime pattern detection by 2028. Physical patrol, arrests, and community interaction remain firmly human. Calibration anchor area.

title: Political scientists
rationale: Almost entirely digital knowledge work: researching political systems, analyzing data, writing papers, and evaluating policy. AI significantly accelerates research, data analysis, and literature review by 2028. Routine political analysis faces strong automation, with senior researchers focusing on novel theoretical contributions.

title: Postal service workers
rationale: Predominantly physical: sorting mail, delivering letters and packages, and operating postal vehicles. Automated sorting machines handle some work, but the physical delivery routes and customer interaction dominate. AI has limited additional impact beyond existing automation.

title: Postsecondary education administrators
rationale: Predominantly digital administrative work: managing student records, overseeing admissions processes, analyzing institutional data, and coordinating programs. AI assists with enrollment management, data analysis, and process automation by 2028. Student and faculty engagement provides interpersonal balance.

title: Postsecondary teachers
rationale: A blend of in-person teaching (lectures, seminars, office hours) and digital knowledge work (research, writing publications, grading, developing course materials). AI significantly assists with research, grading, and content development by 2028. The teaching relationship and original research remain human-driven.

title: Power plant operators, distributors, and dispatchers
rationale: A blend of physical equipment monitoring (operating controls, inspecting equipment) and digital system monitoring (using SCADA systems, monitoring power distribution). AI assists with predictive maintenance and load optimization, but the safety-critical physical plant operation requires human oversight.

title: Preschool and childcare center directors
rationale: A blend of interpersonal management (supervising staff, communicating with parents, ensuring child welfare) and digital administration (budgeting, enrollment management, regulatory compliance). AI assists with administrative tasks by 2028, but the in-person leadership and childcare oversight dominate.

title: Preschool teachers
rationale: Almost entirely interpersonal and physical: teaching young children through play, supervising activities, assessing developmental progress, and communicating with parents. The nurturing, hands-on care of young children is fundamentally human with minimal digital component.

title: Private detectives and investigators
rationale: A blend of physical fieldwork (surveillance, interviewing witnesses, visiting locations) and digital research (searching databases, analyzing records, preparing reports). AI assists with background checks and data analysis by 2028, but physical surveillance and in-person investigation remain essential.

title: Probation officers and correctional treatment specialists
rationale: A blend of interpersonal work (interviewing offenders, conducting home visits, counseling) and digital tasks (writing reports, managing case files, analyzing risk assessments). AI assists with report writing and risk scoring by 2028, but the face-to-face supervision and rehabilitation work remain human.

title: Producers and directors
rationale: A mix of in-person creative leadership (directing actors, managing productions, attending shoots) and digital work (editing, budgeting, scheduling, reviewing content). AI assists with production scheduling and post-production by 2028, but creative vision and on-set leadership remain human.

title: Project management specialists
rationale: Predominantly digital: managing schedules, budgets, and resources using project management software; writing status reports; and coordinating stakeholders. AI copilots significantly assist with scheduling optimization, risk analysis, and reporting by 2028. Cross-functional leadership provides some insulation. Calibration anchor occupation.

title: Property appraisers and assessors
rationale: A blend of physical property inspections and digital analysis (researching comparable sales, analyzing market data, preparing valuation reports). AI assists with automated valuation models and report generation by 2028. Physical property inspections and professional judgment provide meaningful insulation.

title: Property, real estate, and community association managers
rationale: A blend of digital management (financial reporting, lease administration, marketing) and physical on-site work (property inspections, tenant relations, maintenance oversight). AI assists with financial analysis and communication by 2028, but property visits and tenant management remain hands-on.

title: Psychiatric technicians and aides
rationale: Predominantly interpersonal and physical: monitoring patient behavior, assisting with daily activities, providing therapeutic care, and maintaining safe environments. Documentation has a minor digital component, but the hands-on patient care in psychiatric settings dominates.

title: Psychologists
rationale: A blend of interpersonal clinical work (conducting therapy, administering assessments, counseling patients) and digital knowledge work (analyzing research data, writing reports, reviewing literature). AI assists with test interpretation and research by 2028, but the therapeutic relationship and clinical judgment remain human.

title: Public relations and fundraising managers
rationale: Predominantly digital: developing communication strategies, managing media relations, overseeing content creation, and analyzing public perception data. AI significantly assists with content drafting, media monitoring, and sentiment analysis by 2028. Strategic communication and relationship management remain human.

title: Public relations specialists
rationale: Predominantly screen-based: writing press releases, managing social media, monitoring media coverage, and creating promotional content. AI significantly accelerates content creation, media analysis, and campaign optimization by 2028. Client relationship and crisis communication remain human-driven.

title: Public safety telecommunicators
rationale: A blend of interpersonal crisis communication (calming callers, gathering information under pressure) and digital dispatch coordination (using CAD systems, monitoring radio, managing resources). AI assists with call routing and resource optimization by 2028, but the human judgment in emergency triage remains essential.

title: Purchasing managers, buyers, and purchasing agents
rationale: Predominantly digital: evaluating suppliers using databases, negotiating contracts, analyzing market data, and managing procurement systems. AI significantly enhances supplier evaluation, price analysis, and purchase order automation by 2028. Relationship negotiation provides some insulation.

title: Quality control inspectors
rationale: Primarily physical: examining products and materials, operating testing equipment, and conducting on-site inspections. While data recording and statistical analysis have digital components, the hands-on inspection, measurement, and testing work dominates.

title: Radiation therapists
rationale: A blend of clinical patient care (positioning patients, explaining treatments, monitoring during procedures) and digital system operation (operating treatment delivery systems, reviewing treatment plans). AI assists with treatment verification, but patient positioning and care remain hands-on.

title: Radiologic and MRI technologists
rationale: Core work is hands-on: positioning patients, operating imaging equipment, and ensuring patient safety during scans. AI assists with image quality assessment and preliminary analysis by 2028, but the physical patient positioning and equipment operation cannot be automated.

title: Railroad workers
rationale: Predominantly physical: operating locomotives, coupling railcars, inspecting equipment, and managing rail yard operations. Signal and dispatch systems have digital components, but the physical railroad operations dominate.

title: Real estate brokers and sales agents
rationale: Significant digital work: listing properties online, analyzing market data, preparing contracts, and marketing. AI assists with valuation, lead generation, and document preparation by 2028. However, property showings, client relationship building, and negotiation remain interpersonal and physical.

title: Receptionists
rationale: A blend of interpersonal service (greeting visitors, managing front desk) and digital tasks (answering phones, managing schedules, processing correspondence). AI chatbots and virtual receptionists handle many phone and scheduling tasks by 2028, but physical front desk presence remains needed in many settings.

title: Recreation workers
rationale: Predominantly physical and interpersonal: organizing and leading activities, supervising participants, and managing recreation facilities. Administrative tasks like scheduling have digital components, but the in-person activity leadership and participant engagement dominate.

title: Recreational therapists
rationale: Core work is hands-on and interpersonal: planning and directing therapeutic activities, working directly with patients, and assessing treatment progress. Documentation has digital components, but the therapeutic patient interaction and activity facilitation dominate.

title: Registered nurses
rationale: A blend of hands-on patient care (administering medications, monitoring conditions, providing treatments) and digital documentation (updating EHR, reviewing test results, coordinating care). AI assists with clinical decision support and documentation by 2028, but bedside nursing care remains fundamentally human. Calibration anchor.

title: Rehabilitation counselors
rationale: Predominantly interpersonal: counseling clients with disabilities, developing rehabilitation plans, and coordinating community resources. Case documentation and research have digital components, but the face-to-face counseling relationship and advocacy work dominate.

title: Respiratory therapists
rationale: Core work is hands-on clinical care: administering breathing treatments, operating ventilators, and monitoring patients with respiratory conditions. AI assists with treatment protocol recommendations by 2028, but the physical patient care and equipment management dominate.

title: Retail sales workers
rationale: Predominantly in-person: greeting customers, demonstrating products, operating registers, and maintaining displays. E-commerce and AI chatbots affect the broader retail sector, but in-store sales work requires physical presence and interpersonal service.

title: Roofers
rationale: Entirely physical outdoor work: inspecting roofs, installing shingles, applying coatings, and working at heights. This is a calibration anchor for minimal digital exposure—pure manual construction trade with no meaningful AI impact.

title: Sales engineers
rationale: Predominantly digital: preparing technical presentations, analyzing client needs, writing proposals, and demonstrating complex products. AI assists with proposal generation, product configuration, and client research by 2028. Client relationship management and technical consulting remain human-driven.

title: Sales managers
rationale: Predominantly digital: analyzing sales data, developing strategies, managing CRM systems, and preparing reports. AI significantly assists with forecasting, pipeline analysis, and performance tracking by 2028. Team leadership, client relationship building, and strategic decisions remain human.

title: School and career counselors and advisors
rationale: Core work is interpersonal: counseling students, facilitating career exploration, and supporting social-emotional development. AI assists with career matching, resource recommendations, and data tracking by 2028, but the personal counseling relationship and student advocacy remain fundamentally human.

title: Secretaries and administrative assistants
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: scheduling meetings, managing correspondence, preparing documents, and maintaining records. AI significantly automates scheduling, document preparation, and communication management by 2028. Active headcount reduction as AI handles routine administrative tasks.

title: Securities, commodities, and financial services sales agents
rationale: Predominantly digital: analyzing financial markets, executing trades, preparing client recommendations, and managing portfolios. AI significantly assists with market analysis, trade execution, and client reporting by 2028. Client relationship building and complex advisory remain human.

title: Security guards and gambling surveillance officers
rationale: Predominantly physical: patrolling property, monitoring entrances, responding to incidents, and enforcing rules. Surveillance camera monitoring is a digital component where AI assists, but physical security presence and response remain essential.

title: Semiconductor processing technicians
rationale: Primarily physical cleanroom work: operating semiconductor manufacturing equipment, monitoring processes, and conducting quality tests. Process monitoring systems are computerized, but the physical equipment operation and cleanroom procedures dominate.

title: Set and exhibit designers
rationale: Significant digital work: creating 3D models, rendering designs, and using CAD software. AI generative design tools assist with concept development and visualization by 2028. Physical construction oversight, material selection, and on-site installation provide non-digital balance.

title: Sheet metal workers
rationale: Predominantly physical skilled trade: cutting, bending, and installing sheet metal using hand and power tools. Blueprint reading and CNC operation are minor digital components. AI has negligible impact on the hands-on fabrication and installation work.

title: Skincare specialists
rationale: Almost entirely physical and interpersonal: performing facials, body treatments, and skin assessments through direct hands-on work. Appointment scheduling is a negligible digital component. AI cannot perform physical skin care treatments.

title: Small engine mechanics
rationale: Predominantly hands-on: inspecting, servicing, and repairing small engines and motorized equipment using hand tools and diagnostic equipment. Service manual lookup has a minor digital component. AI has minimal impact on the physical repair work.

title: Social and community service managers
rationale: A blend of interpersonal management (staff supervision, community outreach, client advocacy) and digital administrative work (grant writing, budgeting, program reporting). AI assists with reporting and analysis by 2028, but community leadership and client-facing work remain human.

title: Social and human service assistants
rationale: A mix of interpersonal casework (assisting clients, coordinating services, conducting intakes) and digital tasks (maintaining records, researching resources). AI assists with resource matching and documentation by 2028, but the face-to-face client support and advocacy remain human.

title: Social workers
rationale: Predominantly interpersonal: counseling individuals and families, conducting assessments, connecting clients with resources, and advocating for vulnerable populations. Case documentation and research have digital components AI assists with by 2028, but the therapeutic relationship and advocacy work remain fundamentally human.

title: Sociologists
rationale: Predominantly digital knowledge work: designing research studies, analyzing survey data, building statistical models, and writing papers. AI significantly assists with data analysis, literature review, and report generation by 2028. Fieldwork interviews and community observation provide some non-digital balance.

title: Software developers, quality assurance analysts, and testers
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: writing code, designing software systems, debugging, and testing applications. AI coding agents handle routine feature implementation and bug fixes autonomously by 2028. Active restructuring in junior developer roles, though architectural decisions and complex problem-solving retain strong human value.

title: Solar photovoltaic installers
rationale: Almost entirely physical outdoor work: installing solar panels on rooftops, wiring electrical systems, and performing maintenance. System design tools have digital components, but the hands-on installation work at heights dominates. AI has negligible impact.

title: Special education teachers
rationale: Core work is deeply interpersonal: adapting instruction for students with disabilities, developing individualized education programs, and providing behavioral support. AI assists with lesson customization and progress tracking by 2028, but the patient, individualized teaching relationship is fundamentally human.

title: Special effects artists and animators
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: creating 2D/3D models, animations, and visual effects using digital tools. AI significantly automates routine animation, texture generation, and effects work by 2028. Active restructuring in production-level VFX and animation roles, though creative direction retains human value.

title: Speech-language pathologists
rationale: Core work is hands-on clinical: assessing and treating speech, language, and swallowing disorders through direct patient interaction. AI assists with assessment scoring and therapy planning by 2028, but the personalized therapeutic interventions and patient rapport remain fundamentally human.

title: Stationary engineers and boiler operators
rationale: Predominantly physical: operating and maintaining boilers, engines, and mechanical equipment. Computerized monitoring systems assist with controls, but physical equipment operation, inspection, and emergency response require hands-on presence.

title: Substance abuse, behavioral disorder, and mental health counselors
rationale: Core work is deeply interpersonal: conducting therapy sessions, building trust with clients, facilitating group sessions, and providing crisis intervention. Case documentation has digital components, but the therapeutic relationship and emotional support are fundamentally human and cannot be automated.

title: Surgical assistants and technologists
rationale: Almost entirely hands-on: preparing operating rooms, sterilizing equipment, passing instruments during surgery, and maintaining the sterile field. Documentation is a minor digital component. The physical surgical environment work cannot be automated by AI.

title: Survey researchers
rationale: Almost entirely digital: designing surveys, collecting data through digital platforms, analyzing statistical results, and writing reports. AI significantly automates survey design, data collection, and analysis by 2028. Routine survey research faces strong automation pressure.

title: Surveying and mapping technicians
rationale: A blend of physical fieldwork (operating surveying equipment, collecting ground measurements) and digital tasks (processing data, creating maps using GIS, preparing reports). AI assists with data processing and automated mapping by 2028, balanced by essential field data collection.

title: Surveyors
rationale: Significant fieldwork: operating precision instruments, measuring land boundaries, and collecting on-site data. Digital data processing and map preparation use GPS and GIS tools where AI assists. The essential physical field measurement work provides meaningful insulation.

title: Tax examiners and collectors, and revenue agents
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: reviewing tax returns, conducting audits using software, analyzing financial records, and processing collections. AI significantly automates return review, anomaly detection, and compliance checking by 2028. Routine tax examination faces strong automation.

title: Taxi drivers, shuttle drivers, and chauffeurs
rationale: Core work is physical: driving vehicles, navigating routes, and providing passenger service. Ride-hailing apps are digital platforms, but the fundamental task of safely transporting passengers requires physical presence. Autonomous vehicles remain limited by 2028.

title: Teacher assistants
rationale: Predominantly interpersonal: working directly with students, reinforcing lessons, supervising activities, and maintaining classroom order. Some administrative and grading tasks have digital components, but the face-to-face student support and classroom assistance dominate.

title: Technical writers
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: writing manuals, how-to guides, and documentation using specialized tools. AI writing tools by 2028 can generate much of routine technical documentation from source code and specifications. Active headcount reduction in standard technical writing roles.

title: Telecommunications technicians
rationale: Predominantly hands-on: installing routers, running cables, configuring equipment, and troubleshooting network issues at customer sites. Diagnostic software assists with troubleshooting, but the physical installation and repair work dominates.

title: Tellers
rationale: Predominantly screen-based transaction processing: cashing checks, depositing money, and managing account inquiries using banking software. ATMs and digital banking reduce demand, and AI chatbots handle routine queries. However, in-person customer service and complex transactions provide some continued need.

title: Top executives
rationale: A blend of digital strategic work (analyzing business data, reviewing reports, financial planning) and interpersonal leadership (managing teams, building stakeholder relationships, making high-stakes decisions). AI assists with data analysis and report generation by 2028, but strategic vision, organizational leadership, and human judgment remain irreplaceable.

title: Tour and travel guides
rationale: Predominantly in-person and interpersonal: leading groups through attractions, providing live commentary, and managing logistics on-site. AI audio guides and virtual tours exist, but the personalized human experience of live guided tours remains valued.

title: Training and development managers
rationale: Predominantly digital: developing training programs, managing learning management systems, analyzing skills data, and coordinating development initiatives. AI assists with content creation, needs assessment, and program analytics by 2028. Team leadership and strategic talent development remain human.

title: Training and development specialists
rationale: Significant digital work: creating training materials, developing e-learning content, and assessing training effectiveness. AI tools significantly assist with content creation and assessment design by 2028. In-person facilitation and interactive training delivery provide interpersonal balance.

title: Transportation, storage, and distribution managers
rationale: Predominantly digital management: analyzing logistics data, optimizing routes, managing supply chain systems, and coordinating distribution. AI significantly enhances logistics optimization and demand forecasting by 2028. Physical warehouse oversight and staff management provide some balance.

title: Travel agents
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: researching travel options, booking reservations, preparing itineraries, and managing client accounts using online platforms. AI significantly automates trip planning, price comparison, and booking by 2028. Active displacement as AI tools handle routine travel arrangements.

title: Tutors
rationale: A blend of interpersonal teaching (working one-on-one with students, adapting instruction, providing motivation) and digital content delivery. AI tutoring tools provide significant competition for basic subject matter tutoring by 2028, but personalized human tutoring for complex subjects and test preparation retains value.

title: Umpires, referees, and other sports officials
rationale: Predominantly physical and interpersonal: officiating games, making real-time judgment calls, managing player conduct, and maintaining game flow. Video replay technology assists with some decisions, but the on-field human presence and authority remain essential.

title: Urban and regional planners
rationale: Predominantly digital: analyzing demographic data, using GIS tools, developing land use plans, writing reports, and preparing presentations. AI assists with data analysis, impact modeling, and plan drafting by 2028. Community meetings and site assessments provide interpersonal/physical balance.

title: Veterinarians
rationale: A blend of hands-on clinical work (examining animals, performing surgery, administering treatments) and digital tasks (maintaining records, interpreting diagnostics, researching treatments). AI assists with diagnostic imaging and record management by 2028, but the physical examination and treatment of animals remain human. Calibration anchor.

title: Veterinary assistants and laboratory animal caretakers
rationale: Almost entirely physical: feeding and watering animals, cleaning cages, restraining animals for examination, and maintaining facilities. Record-keeping is a minor digital component. AI has negligible impact on hands-on animal care.

title: Veterinary technologists and technicians
rationale: Predominantly hands-on: performing medical tests on animals, assisting in surgery, collecting samples, and administering treatments. Lab results processing and records management have digital components, but the physical animal care and clinical work dominate.

title: Waiters and waitresses
rationale: Almost entirely physical and interpersonal: taking orders, serving food, managing tables, and providing customer service. POS systems are minor digital tools. AI has minimal impact on the in-person dining service that defines this role.

title: Water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators
rationale: A blend of physical equipment operation (adjusting controls, collecting samples, maintaining equipment) and computerized system monitoring. AI assists with process optimization and predictive maintenance, but the safety-critical physical plant operations require human oversight and hands-on work.

title: Water transportation workers
rationale: Predominantly physical: operating vessels, maintaining equipment, managing cargo, and ensuring maritime safety. Navigation systems are digital tools, but the physical operation of ships and boats in variable conditions requires human presence.

title: Web developers and digital designers
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: designing and coding websites, implementing user interfaces, and managing digital content. AI coding and design tools by 2028 handle much of routine web development—generating layouts, writing standard code, and testing. Active headcount reduction in basic web development roles.

title: Welders, cutters, solderers, and brazers
rationale: Almost entirely physical skilled trade work: joining metal parts using welding equipment, cutting materials, and inspecting welds. Blueprint reading is a minor digital component. AI has negligible impact on this hands-on manufacturing and construction trade.

title: Wholesale and manufacturing sales representatives
rationale: Significant digital work: researching customers, preparing presentations, managing CRM systems, and processing orders. AI assists with lead scoring, proposal generation, and market analysis by 2028. In-person client relationships, product demonstrations, and negotiation provide meaningful interpersonal balance.

title: Wind turbine technicians
rationale: Predominantly physical: climbing wind turbines, inspecting equipment, performing maintenance and repairs at height, and troubleshooting mechanical/electrical systems. Diagnostic monitoring systems are digital tools, but the dangerous physical fieldwork dominates.

title: Woodworkers
rationale: Predominantly physical: operating saws, planers, and other woodworking machinery, and hand-crafting products. CNC programming has a minor digital component, but the physical cutting, shaping, and finishing of wood products dominates this manufacturing trade.

title: Writers and authors
rationale: Almost entirely screen-based: researching topics, drafting content, revising text, and managing publications. AI writing tools by 2028 can generate first drafts, suggest revisions, and handle routine content. Active restructuring in content writing, copywriting, and commercial writing, though distinctive voice and creative literary work retain human value.

title: Zoologists and wildlife biologists
rationale: A blend of physical fieldwork (observing animals in habitat, collecting specimens, tagging wildlife) and digital knowledge work (analyzing data, writing research papers, using GIS for habitat mapping). AI assists with data analysis and species identification by 2028, balanced by essential outdoor field research.
